# Big Foot Floors

> Big Foot Floors makes floors and bespoke interiors from bog wood: bog oak and bog ash raised from lakes and peat bogs, radiocarbon-dated and processed in Lithuania.

## Facts
- Material: bog oak and bog ash. The trees were not felled; they fell into water long ago and were preserved there.
- Sourcing: the team has dived and cleaned lakes for more than 20 years. Divers search for trunks around the world.
- Authentication: wood is dated by radiocarbon (carbon) dating.
- Family business, third generation. Production in Lithuania.
- Floors are multilayer boards: resistant to sunlight and wear, stable with changes in temperature and humidity, compatible with underfloor heating.
- Installation by the company's own craftsmen, worldwide. Aftercare and repair are offered.
- Other woods: oak, elm, ash, black walnut.
- Products: floors (patterns, colours), stairs, walls, ceilings, tables, wine cellars, yacht flooring.
